concept: Signal Box's first line language, relaid the way a railway draws its track: straight runs, every turn one 45-degree chamfer, a terminus ring where a line begins and a real T buffer stop where it ends, and a line drawn only where there is an order (time, sequence, or a head's bracket gathering its own keys). Steel lines are painted on green-black slate boards with a 12px lamp at every stop in one legend; the tube's own light (layered halo, bloom, scanlines, breathing lamps) is back on the short list of live things, and everything else stays matte steel and slate.
companions: Steel #a7c4d8 is the one companion, and it has a job: 'here' (the bar's latched cell with its 3px run and ring lamp, the latched key in every bracket, the Settings list, today's date key on the month), hollow 'to come' rings, links and the ends of lines. Its darker kin draw the diagram: --rail #607385 for the 2px running lines, --wire #4f5e6b (raised from #394652 so brackets register at 1x) for 1px brackets and branch ticks, --buffer #8a9aa8 for buffer stops and the 'not looked up yet' note, pewter #6f7b85 for 'off'. Green-black slate #0f1519 is the material behind every board, with #161c20 plates and a #26313a latch. Each colour now does one job: sage #86d9a6 is done (and a hovered row's afterglow edge), amber is late or needs a look and nothing else (lamps, stamps, the setup board's edge, Settings' 'Needs a look'), cyan marks the plans' stops and the month. The kinds keep their colour in the ring lamp alone and are named in ink: restaurant moved off amber to terracotta #df987c, outing off sage to moss #b5c87d, seasonal to wheat #c3a85d. The cobalt corner wash is off (washGlow 0).
title: What shall we *line* up? The box's label on Home. 'Line up' is how a family says it will arrange things (the weekend, a trip, a reminder, a present), so it asks them to tell Vera what to put in order, and the lit word is the motif the whole page is drawn in: the question glows at the head of the page as the now lamp glows at the head of the track.
decisions: One grammar, written once as shared parts (.stop, .buffer, .rail/.bracket, the chamfer, .timetable, .station, .rows) and one lamp legend. A line only where there is an order: Coming up, To do and its page, Chat, the plans list, setting up on Home and on /setup, Who answers and its fallback, Sign in, the 404, a head's bracket. Sets (Lately added, the kids, Keys, Connected to, the Ideas list, Settings) keep lamps and hairlines and get no rail.

Every turn is one 45-degree chamfer drawn as a 14px square (the bracket's drop, Status's turnout, Sign in's turn into the button); there is no curve anywhere. Lines end on a lamp or a T buffer (a 14x2 bar on a 2x10 upright, turned for a horizontal line) with the way on beside it: All plans, All 4, 4 shown, All the setup steps, Back to the start, and now 'If that one cannot' on Status's siding.

Page heads: a 2.6rem terminus ring in the section's ink on dark glass, matte; the 44px Archivo title; the primary on the title's baseline outside the bracket. Only a head holding keys draws a line: a 1px wire from the ring's foot, one chamfer, a shelf the keys stand on, a 7px upright tick. Folds drop below the bracket through details::details-content, so they work with scripts off. The search key now shrinks, so the To do bracket no longer overflows at tablet width.

'Here' is one drawing everywhere: a latched #26313a cell, a 3px steel run at its foot and a 12px steel ring lamp on it, on the bar's 1px #2e343b main line; turned to the top edge on the phone's tab bar and vertical in the Settings list. The bar names every place in words.

Home, setting up: a vertical station line from an amber terminus, amber hollow stops, the first step lit in the phosphor (you are here), a buffer beside 'All the setup steps', on slate with only the amber edge. Each step is now exactly a 44px row (the stock .6rem gap is gone), its stop set on the first line, so a wrapped step on the phone still reads as a list and the rail is cut clean under the buffer.

Home, Coming up: Signal Box's fortnight. The page's one breathing now lamp labelled 'now', its first stretch lit with a hot core, cyan stops, 34px DM Mono day figures with the month and weekday stacked, plates hung on fine drops. The four plates now span the board at one height (stretched to the row), their gap and padding trimmed and the titles set -0.01em so 'Mount St. Helens day trip' holds one line; the rail runs one plate past the last stop to its buffer and All plans. On the phone the day figures stand in a margin left of the rail instead of on top of it.

Home, To do: a timetable with a 9rem margin of one-line stamps (amber once late, the time too), stops on the rail, a steady lit now tick, rows of tick well, title and whose on hairlines (whose now ends under WHO), a buffer beside All 4. On a phone the margin folds away and each stamp goes under its title in the same words, and 'now' stays as a label beside its tick, so late is never colour alone.

Home, the rest: the kids' wishes run under both columns with the kids side by side, so the two columns end together (Home 1788px, from 1895), and Something to eat is the last row of Lately added, drawn like the others (terracotta ring, title, '2 restaurants to try', an arrow), not a boxed plate with a tracked eyebrow.

Chat: her screen is the terminus of a 2px track down the left gutter of one slate board, now with a 5.75rem margin so the stamps sit inside the tray. Her lines hang by a 28px glyph with times in the margin, on a square plate like everything else (the round corner is gone; the green-black fill and green edge say it is hers).
